# Shooting Cut

> Canonical English site: https://shootingcut.com/
> Simplified Chinese site: https://shootingcut.cn/
> Current product version: 1.1.3

Shooting Cut is a competitive-shooting video editor for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It combines on-device timer and shot analysis with trimming, sequential full-match assembly, two-view synchronization, 2–3-camera editing, score-aware overlays, person-tracked reframing, and export. Timer and gunshot analysis is one editing capability within the broader editor.

This file supplements the public HTML pages and XML sitemap. Product facts, limits, and routes should be verified against those canonical sources.

## Platforms and editing modes

- Requires iOS 26.0+, iPadOS 26.0+, or macOS 26.0+.
- Auto Trim accepts exactly 1 video.
- Merge combines up to 20 sequential clips into one long video.
- Split Sync accepts exactly 2 simultaneous views and offers Full Screen, Dual View: Center HUD, Dual View: Top HUD, and Side by Side layouts.
- Stage Mix accepts 2–3 simultaneous inputs labeled POV, Follow, or Static, uses movement-aware switching, and allows manual override.

## Free, Pro, subscription, and upload facts

- Auto Trim and score import are free.
- Free Auto Trim exports include the Shooting Cut watermark and logo intro card.
- Pro removes the Shooting Cut watermark, enables custom intro cards, unlocks Split Sync and Stage Mix, enables direct upload to YouTube and Facebook, and enables macOS batch export.
- One subscription covers all of the subscriber's Apple devices, subject to App Store account and entitlement rules.
- Direct upload to YouTube and Facebook is a Pro feature.

## Results, official shot times, and overlays

- Supported result-import families are PractiScore, ESS, HDP, and IDPA.
- When a PractiScore result includes official per-shot timer records, Shooting Cut can align them to footage using the timer beep and use official times, splits, shot count, and score data in video subtitles.
- ESS, HDP, and IDPA support score import but do not provide the same PractiScore-style official per-shot timing anchor.
- Result import depends on the source remaining available at import time. Imported records can remain associated with the shooter's own local match-video archive.

## Reframe, Track, and export boundaries

- Auto Trim, Merge, and Stage Mix support Reframe and Track. Auto Trim and Merge also support manual crop.
- Track supports cropped 9:16, 3:4, 4:5, 6:7, and 1:1 outputs.
- Source keeps the source frame. Non-tracked 16:9 is separate from the Track crop ratios.
- General export choices can include Original, 4K, 1080p, and 720p, filtered by source and workflow ceilings.
- Tracked crops use a 1080-pixel short edge and can be downscaled to 720p.
- Split Sync output is controlled by the selected product layout and uses a 1080-pixel short edge.

## On-device processing and connected features

- Core video/audio analysis, editing, export, and person tracking run on the user's Apple device.
- Original footage is not uploaded to a Shooting Cut media-processing server for those core workflows.
- Apple Photos, iCloud Photos, and iCloud Drive follow Apple services and the user's settings.
- iCloud key-value storage can sync lightweight app metadata such as media aliases, camera views, firearm types, score associations, and imported match fields, plus an existing non-anonymous custom RevenueCat App User ID. Values beginning with `$RCAnonymousID:` are excluded. Original media, PCM audio, and person-tracking paths do not use that store.
- RevenueCat receives subscription identifiers and entitlement status.
- Help Improve Gunshot Detection is user-controlled and currently enabled by default. When enabled, limited pseudonymous derived detection and correction fields can be sent to Apple CloudKit; original audio, original video, and PCM are excluded.
- Score import and user-initiated YouTube or Facebook uploads use the network.

## Start here

- [Competitive-shooting video editor](https://shootingcut.com/competitive-shooting-video-editor/): choose among Auto Trim, Merge, Split Sync, and Stage Mix, with score, Reframe, Free, and Pro boundaries.
- [On-device shooting video editor](https://shootingcut.com/on-device-shooting-video-editor/): review local processing and the iCloud, subscription, improvement-data, import, and upload boundaries.

## Core workflow guides

- [Auto Trim one shooting match video](https://shootingcut.com/auto-trim-shooting-match-video/): analyze and trim exactly one stage recording, then verify timer, shot, trim, score, and subtitle details.
- [Sync two shooting videos by timer beep](https://shootingcut.com/sync-two-shooting-videos-by-timer-beep/): align exactly two simultaneous views and choose a Split Sync layout.
- [Edit a multi-camera shooting video](https://shootingcut.com/edit-multi-camera-shooting-video/): use Stage Mix with 2–3 POV, Follow, or Static inputs and review the proposed camera switches.
- [Shot-detection troubleshooting](https://shootingcut.com/shot-detection-troubleshooting/): review AGC, neighboring shots, echo or reverb, weak timer beeps, and manual correction controls.
- [Reframe landscape shooting video for social formats](https://shootingcut.com/reframe-landscape-shooting-video-for-social-media/): separate Source and non-tracked 16:9 from supported Track crop ratios and workflow export ceilings.
- [Merge USPSA stage videos](https://shootingcut.com/merge-uspsa-stage-videos/): arrange Stage 1 through Stage N and combine up to 20 clips into one Full Match video.

## Advanced workflow guides

- [Side-by-side shooting video comparison](https://shootingcut.com/side-by-side-shooting-video-comparison/): use the Pro Side by Side Split Sync layout with exactly two recordings.
- [Batch export match videos](https://shootingcut.com/batch-export-match-videos/): create multiple separate exports with macOS Pro.
- [Import PractiScore, ESS, HDP, and IDPA match results](https://shootingcut.com/import-practiscore-ess-hdp-match-results/): import supported results while the source remains available and associate them with local match video.
- [Thailand HDP and ESS match results](https://shootingcut.com/thailand-hdp-ess-match-results/): import accessible Thailand results and keep the imported record with the shooter's own archive.
- [Add official shot times and scores to match video](https://shootingcut.com/add-shot-times-and-scores-to-match-video/): align available PractiScore official per-shot records to footage and review the overlay before export.
